visualCharacteristics.purpose: dated list of ASX releases with a client-side pager (Previous, page numbers, Next) and a "Showing x–y of N" count

contentPattern.structure: optional first row: Page size | number (default 10); then one row per release: date cell (plain text, e.g. 19 November 2026) | title cell (link, or plain text)

reuseGuidance: Use for long dated lists of releases or announcements that need paging. Place directly after a releases-filter block in the same section to make it searchable; paging follows the filter.
